annual.unit_note: Counts are rider rows (one row per injured e-scooter rider), not crashes. Two crashes carry two riders, so 522 rider rows come from 520 crashes. Both counts are given per year; severity is a rider attribute and is counted on rider rows.
annual.age_reference_note: The model frame names the age reference level '25to54', but the stage-two merge set the older band at 45 and over, so the reference level covers ages 25 to 44. It is labelled 25 to 44 here.
annual.note_2021: 2021 carries no O-coded crash at all. That is reported rather than smoothed, and it is the reason the 2021/2022 breakpoint is untestable.

skipped.M2: not part of this task; not estimated

cv_fold_level.pairing_basis: RepeatedStratifiedKFold splits depend only on the outcome vector and n, which are identical across rungs, and the seed is shared, so fold k of one rung holds the same test rows as fold k of every other rung.
cv_fold_level.reading: Lower log loss is better, so a negative difference means the first model named is better on that fold. The fifty folds overlap across repeats, so the SD of the differences is descriptive and is not a standard error of the mean difference.

transferability_detail.covariate_pool: M1 (34 covariates), screened per split by transferability.estimable_in_both with min cell 5
transferability_detail.se_ratio_definition: standard error of a slope in the subgroup fit divided by the standard error of the same slope in the pooled fit on the same covariate set; the maximum and the median over covariates are reported

bootstrap.note: rerun here on the current frame with transferability.temporal_test and spatial_test; the stored file's values are kept under stored_values_pre_final_labels in each split

temporal_2022.reason: 2021 contains 30 crashes and none coded O, so a 2021/2022 split has an empty outcome category in the earlier period and no ordered model can be fitted to it. Reported as untestable rather than forced by merging categories.

large_city_definition.rule_as_written: A literal set of six city names inside transferability.spatial_test. No selection rule is stated in the code or prespec.md. The result label in the same function reads 'five largest reporting cities against the rest', which does not match the six names.

not_largest_by_reports.note: The set is not the largest reporting jurisdictions: records with City_ID 'Not Listed' and several cities outside the set carry more rider rows than Fort Worth and El Paso.

transferability_detail.stored_file_status: transferability.json written 2026-09-14 from the frame with fused reference-run cue labels; model_frame.csv was rebuilt with the final adjudicated labels on 2026-09-16

benchmark_detail.selection: No hyperparameter is selected. Each grid point is fitted as its own model on every fold and all four configurations are reported; there is no inner tuning loop and nothing is chosen on the evaluation folds.

resampling.scheme: RepeatedStratifiedKFold, stratified on the three-class outcome

calibration_inside_training_folds.what_the_code_does: run() passes the binary final cue labels from model_frame.csv straight to every model. No probability is calibrated anywhere in the benchmark, inside or outside the folds, so the claim describes a step that does not exist. No fold leakage arises from calibration because there is none.

shap_settings.model: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300, min_samples_leaf=5), not one of the grid points

benchmark_detail.stored_file_status: benchmark.json written 2026-09-14 from the frame with fused reference-run cue labels; model_frame.csv was rebuilt with the final adjudicated labels on 2026-09-16
benchmark_detail.recomputed_with: benchmark.run and benchmark.shap_salience on the current frame

shap_full.interpretation: predictive salience only; these are not causal effects and are not described as importance

extraction_intervals_calibration.validation_sample: batch 1 probability sample, 150 narratives, three coders, majority-vote gold

calibration.status: New. No calibration code exists elsewhere in src: no isotonic or other calibration map is fitted by any script before this one, and no calibrated probability enters any model.
calibration.scored_quantity: Route B vote share over the repeated runs (runs per narrative: [5]) against the batch-1 gold label
calibration.method: isotonic regression fitted on the training folds and applied to the held-out fold, stratified K-fold per cue with K = min(5, gold positives), so no narrative contributes to the map applied to itself
calibration.weights: unweighted, and inverse-probability weighted by the validation sampling weights; the sample oversamples predicted positives, so the weighted figures are the ones that describe the population
calibration.injury_cues: not scored; vote shares exist only for the ten mechanism cues

age.unrecorded_age_handling: age_unknown indicator kept in every specification; for the spline and linear forms unrecorded ages are filled with the median recorded age (23) so the indicator carries the shift

no_age_terms_model.note: M1 without age bands, keeping age_unknown; the nested base for every likelihood-ratio test

age.literature_for_cut_offs: not compiled here; outside the scope of a data run
age.comparison_note: Band specifications are not nested in one another, so they are compared by AIC and BIC; likelihood-ratio tests are given only for nested pairs.

complete_case.definition: located crash (coordinates present) and age, gender and ethnicity all recorded; ethnicity unknown read from the raw Prsn_Ethnicity_ID (missing or 'Unknown'), because the model frame pools it with 'other'
complete_case.comparison_note: ka_excluding_zero_primary is restricted to the covariates the complete-case model can carry; the indicators dropped as constant cannot be compared
complete_case.multiple_imputation: prespec.md section 2.3 also names a chained-equations multiple-imputation sensitivity (m = 20). No code in src implements it and it is not computed here.

missingness_mechanism.excluded_by_design: poverty_share and road_density_km_100m are left out of every model because they are imputed from the city median exactly for the coordinate-missing rows
missingness_mechanism.reading: A severity block that is associated with missingness after adjustment means the indicator is not missing completely at random with respect to the outcome. None of these models can distinguish missing at random from missing not at random.

speed_limit.alternatives_in_pipeline: none. The only treatment coded anywhere in src is the pre-specified band coding in model_frame._speed_band; no other speed-limit form is fitted by any script
speed_limit.primary_treatment: bands: 30 mph or below (reference), 35 to 40, 45 and over, unknown (raw -1 or missing)

acs_vintage.missing_value_rule: city median, then overall median, for both vintages (model_frame.build)
acs_vintage.status: acs_extraction_audit.json held only the column metadata; the model refits are new here

bike_facility_buffers.note: each indicator is added to M1 one at a time and refitted on the current frame; the nearest-segment form is included for completeness although it was excluded at screening

five_class.estimability_rule: fixed before fitting: optimizer converged, separation screen clean, and at least 1 event per parameter in the smallest class
five_class.prespec: prespec.md section 2 states the five-class ordering is not estimated because of the fatality count; this is an attempt made as an exploratory check and is reported as such
five_class.ame_note: Reported for completeness. With the estimability rule failed these are not interpreted.

riders_and_crashes.note: Cue labels are extracted per narrative, which is per crash, so the two two-rider crashes carry the same cue values on both rider rows.
